intro.en: Laevatain joined Endfield Industries from Rhodes Island on the Endministrator's own recommendation and reports directly to the Endministrator.
intro.zh-TW: 萊萬汀出身羅德島，由管理員直接引薦加入終末地工業，是管理員的直屬幹員。

basic.en: Heat combo of up to 5 hits. The final strike deals 18 Stagger while she is the controlled operator.
basic.zh-TW: 最多 5 段的灼熱傷害連擊。作為主控幹員時，重擊造成 18 點失衡。

battle.en: A Magma Fragment hits repeatedly for Heat damage; a hit gives 1 stack of Melting Flame. Cast at 4 stacks, it spends them on 1 extra hit over a large area that forces a short Combustion and returns Ultimate Energy.
battle.zh-TW: 熔核碎片持續攻擊，造成灼熱傷害；命中獲得 1 層熔火。在已有 4 層熔火時施放，會消耗全部層數追加 1 次大範圍攻擊，強制施加短暫的燃燒，並回復終結技能量。

combo.en: Trigger: an enemy gains Combustion or Corrosion. Fire erupts under every such enemy for Heat damage, giving 1 stack of Melting Flame and Ultimate Energy per enemy hit.
combo.zh-TW: 觸發條件：有敵人進入燃燒或腐蝕狀態。所有處於這兩種狀態的敵人腳下噴出火焰，造成灼熱傷害；命中獲得 1 層熔火，每命中一個敵人另得終結技能量。

ultimate.en: She becomes the controlled operator and her basic attacks are enhanced for a time; hit 3 of the combo applies Heat Infliction. Casting Smouldering Fire or Seethe does not shorten the duration.
ultimate.zh-TW: 切換為主控幹員，一段時間內普通攻擊得到強化；第 3 段施加灼熱附著。施放焚滅或沸騰不會縮短持續時間。

talents.en: After the controlled operator's final strike or finisher hits, she absorbs Heat Infliction from nearby enemies, 1 stack of Melting Flame each, up to 4. At 4 stacks her damage ignores 10 Heat Resistance for 20 s (15 at Promotion I, 20 at Promotion III).
talents.zh-TW: 主控幹員的重擊或處決命中後，吸收周圍敵人的灼熱附著，每層換 1 層熔火，最多 4 層。達到 4 層後，她的傷害無視敵人 10 點灼熱抗性，持續 20 秒（精英化I 為 15 點，精英化III 為 20 點）。

talents.en: Below 40% HP she gains 90% Protection and restores 5% of max HP per second for 4 s (8 s at Promotion III), at most once every 120 s.
talents.zh-TW: 生命值低於 40% 時獲得 90% 庇護，並每秒回復 5% 最大生命值，持續 4 秒（精英化III 為 8 秒），每 120 秒最多一次。

potentials.en: Smouldering Fire's extra hit deals 1.2 times its damage and returns 20 SP on hit.
potentials.zh-TW: 焚滅的追加攻擊傷害提升為 1.2 倍，命中後返還 20 點技力。

potentials.en: Combustion from Smouldering Fire lasts 50% longer and deals 1.5 times its damage.
potentials.zh-TW: 焚滅造成的燃燒持續時間 +50%，傷害提升為 1.5 倍。
黃昏所需的終結技能量 -15%。

potentials.en: Enhanced basic attacks of Twilight deal 1.2 times their damage; each enemy she defeats during it adds 1 s, up to 7 s.
potentials.zh-TW: 黃昏的強化普通攻擊傷害提升為 1.2 倍；期間每擊敗一個敵人延長 1 秒，最多 7 秒。
